identity.same_source_version_different_sha256: identity conflict; no snapshot or source offset advancement

projection.missing_source_policy: data snapshot is partial and names every missing or partial source; missing values are never replaced with zero

barriers.success: source snapshot, source facts, data snapshot, provenance, outbox, job result and inbox commit in one PostgreSQL transaction before source offset commit
barriers.deterministic_domain_failure: failed job and failed inbox receipt commit before source offset commit
barriers.poison_event: canonical dlq.v1 broker ACK precedes source offset commit

order: apply additive PostgreSQL migration and Kafka topic/ACL
start candidate consumer and record assigned-generation readiness
enable authority writer only after the readiness fence is current
reconcile source/data count, hash, watermarks and inbox/outbox
rollout.rollback: disable the authority writer first, drain or stop the candidate consumer, retain jobs, inbox, snapshots and source offsets, then restore the prior image
